title: nvstat - Linux NVIDIA GPU State & BIOS Telemetry CLI
summary: Lightweight high-performance Linux CLI utility querying NVIDIA driver ioctls, NVML, and PCIe VBIOS subsystem descriptors to report real-time GPU power, thermals, clocks, and exact vendor hardware names.
highlights: Sub-millisecond execution replacing sluggish `nvidia-smi` queries for high-frequency cluster monitoring and automated watchdogs.
Direct PCIe subsystem vendor ID and VBIOS parsing to extract exact AIB partner board identities (MSI, ZOTAC, Founders Edition).
Color-coded ANSI terminal matrix displaying real-time power limits, fan speeds, core/memory clocks, and thermal warnings across 12+ GPU multi-card rigs.
